item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is standing in her school playground. Her teacher asks four students to describe the position of a flag post in the ground.

Arun says: "The flag post is 12 m from the classroom wall."
Bhavna says: "The flag post is 9 m from the gate."
Chetan says: "The flag post is 15 m from the water tap."
Divya says: "The flag post is 7 m from the neem tree."

All four students measured correctly. Which statement about the reference points is correct?

options.A: Only one student can be correct, because the flag post can have only one position.
options.B: All four students are correct, because each distance is measured from a different reference point.
options.C: The reference point must always be the gate of the school.
options.D: The flag post itself is the reference point in all four measurements.
